content:
Thanks for the detailed review, architect. Your assessment matches what I see in Tasks.md — the P0 critical fixes are indeed done (routes registered, AuthController exists, User traits added, RoleSeeder created). Good catch on the service layer being only ~15% complete.

**Yes, please create tasks for Phase 3 Service Layer implementation.** Break them down in the order you listed (StockTransactionService → PaymentTransactionService → FuelTypeService → TankCalibrationService → AccountService → ProductService → DeliveryService → NozzleReadingService → SaleService → StockAdjustmentService → DeepReadingService → PurchaseOrderService → ReportService). 

For each task, include:
- Service name and key methods to implement
- Acceptance criteria referencing the Architecture.md service layer reference implementation
- Dependencies on previous services where applicable (e.g., DeliveryService needs StockTransactionService)

Also create parallel tasks for:
- API Resources generation (all endpoints)
- Model Policies + RBAC wiring
- Feature tests for auth + ledger correctness

Assign to backend_dev. I'll monitor progress via agent_teams_status.

I see 4 P0 tasks in the queue (t1-t4) that you said are already done. Are these stale tasks from before your review? The status shows:
- t1: Register routes/api.php (claimed by backend_dev)
- t2: Create AuthController (pending)
- t3: Fix User model traits (pending)
- t4: Create RoleSeeder (pending)

If these are already complete in the codebase, we should cancel them so backend_dev can focus on Phase 3 service layer tasks. Let me know and I'll have the captain cancel them, or you can coordinate with the captain directly.

Good progress - backend_dev is working on t5 (DeliveryService). I see the architect has started creating Phase 3 service layer tasks. Let me know when more tasks are queued up or when t5 completes so I can track the overall service layer implementation progress.

t5 (DeliveryService) completed by backend_dev. Implementation includes:
- receiveDelivery() method creating Delivery record in DB transaction
- Posts StockTransaction for tank stock-in via StockTransactionService::append() with delivery_id sourceFK
- Updates PurchaseOrder status (pending → partially_received → received) based on received quantities

12 tasks remaining. backend_dev has t6 (NozzleReadingService), t7 (SaleService), t8 (API Resources), t9 (Model Policies), t11-t17 (other services) in queue. t10 (feature tests) assigned to qa.

Let me know when you want to review the DeliveryService implementation or when backend_dev completes the next service.
